description: Four product health states. A metric value <= excellent_max is Excellent, <= good_max is Good, <= fair_max is Fair, otherwise Poor. An entity's state is the WORST of its metric states, staleness and security events. Every state change must record the reason and a UTC timestamp in health_history.

anomaly.description: Baseline-driven, beyond static thresholds. A z-score above these values raises the state to at least the given level.

staleness.description: Stale data DOWNGRADES the state; never keep showing the last good value.
